svg.title: From a video clip to 27 emotion ratings
svg.desc: A magnified encoder block identifies the exact intervention and extraction site.
svg.text: From a video clip to 27 emotion ratings
VideoMAE ViT-B/16 | Masked-video pretraining on VCE, followed by fine-tuning on its 27 continuous ratings.

g.text: 12 parallel heads per block × 12 blocks = 144 heads
One head = 64 values per token, before projection.
All heads use scaled dot-product self-attention.
